name: Beat Bartleby
summary: In Stormwind, Bartleby guards the mug a young warrior must claim. The instructors send recruits to face him in a bare-knuckle fight and earn the vessel for their training.

sections.title: A Brawler's Challenge
sections.body: Stormwind's warrior instructors expect recruits to face combat without excuses or grand ceremony. As part of their formal training, young warriors must retrieve a particular mug from Bartleby, a notorious drunkard who lounges in the city. He scoffs at polite requests and swears no one will take his prized drinkware without prying it from his cold, dead fingers. For a fledgling warrior, words soon give way to a fistfight.

sections.title: A Drunken Lesson
sections.body: Bartleby boasts that he will fight to the death, but a thorough thrashing is enough to sober him. Once beaten, his bravado gives way to bruised admiration. He recognizes that his opponent is tougher than they appear and yields peacefully, letting the victor claim the mug and complete the trial at the training hall.

faq.answer: Bartleby is a belligerent drunkard who frequents Stormwind City. He clings to a beloved drinking vessel and tests novice warriors sent to prove their physical resolve.

faq.q: Why do I have to fight Bartleby?
faq.answer: Alliance warrior trainers send recruits to recover a mug in Bartleby's possession. He refuses to give it up without a brawl, so the trainee must defeat him hand to hand to claim it.

faq.q: Do I actually kill Bartleby in this quest?
faq.answer: No. Bartleby boasts that you must pry the mug from his cold, dead fingers, but he surrenders when beaten and admits you are tougher than he expected.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: The confrontation takes place in Stormwind, where Bartleby drinks and loiters.

faq.q: What happens after I defeat him?
faq.answer: After you beat him, Bartleby yields and speaks to you amicably. You can take his mug back to the warrior trainers to complete your initiation.

faq.q: What level of training does this trial represent?
faq.answer: This brawl is an early milestone for fledgling warriors around their tenth season of experience, a practical test of basic melee endurance.

angles.text: As an Alliance warrior, you face this early tavern brawl and learn that force of will and a heavy fist can settle disputes when diplomacy fails.
In Stormwind's capital streets, you glimpse the city's rough underbelly alongside its stately stone walls.
